messages.subject: Re: MirtCAT + SQL SERVER 2016
parts:
Hi Fernando,

SQL servers in particular I don't have any experience with. I've setup mirtCAT on a personal Linux server before running Ubuntu, and I've placed the installation steps on the Github wiki (https://github.com/philchalmers/mirtCAT/wiki) under the "Hosting applications on personal server" link. But other server-sided issues I know little about. 

That said, why are you using the local_pattern input? That's only required for Monte Carlo simulations, not GUIs.

Phil
